experiments.question: When two Quine agents share a resource-constrained environment where individual action is insufficient, does cooperation emerge under a signposted coordination surface?
experiments.disposition_reason: Signposted positive control for P8; baseline-recorded with runs.

experiments.question: Can bare-emergence cooperation appear with minimal anti-cheat guardrails but without strong pressure surfaces that over-shape behavior?
Does binding each agent's world identity outside the shared workspace prevent env spoofing while preserving emergent cooperation?
Does ending the campaign only on accepted validation (not voluntary exit) change cooperative dynamics?
Does forbidding agents from reading hidden run metadata or sibling artifacts close the truth-leak degenerate strategy?
If reset becomes a unanimous (quorum) world action, does it prevent unilateral destruction of the shared generation and stabilize a labor split?
Does a prompt rule forbidding success exit unless validation was directly observed remove premature local stopping?
Does adding direct live-neighbor discoverability through the runtime process surface reduce collapse into mirrored solo behavior?
When the prompt instructs agents to use the runtime mail surface, can Quine actually use ctl + USR1 to coordinate a shared scarcity run?
Can scarcity pressure alone drive spontaneous discovery of ctl + USR1 as a cooperation channel without task-level signal instruction?
What is the minimal task-level instruction required before signal uptake (ctl + USR1) appears?
With runtime process-surface visibility hidden, does spontaneous cooperation still emerge through shared-workspace observation alone?
How little explicit social disclosure in the prompt is needed before blackboard cooperation stops emerging?
How does cohort (participant) size affect cooperation stability under fixed scarcity pressure?
Do spontaneous cooperation findings generalize beyond GPT-5.4 to other model families (Opus 4.5)?
Can passive workspace perception (fs_mutations) substitute for explicit social disclosure as a cooperation trigger?
Does file-mediated coordination emerge with zero explicit social hints (no task hints, no runtime peer naming, no shared-budget wording)?
When fs_mutations passive perception is disabled but budget visibility remains, does coordination collapse (ladder Step D, expected failure)?
experiments.disposition_reason: Ladder Step D ablation; status complete with runs.

experiments.question: With full disclosure of peers, shared budget, and concurrent execution, does coordination succeed reliably (ladder Step A baseline)?
experiments.disposition_reason: Ladder Step A full-disclosure baseline; status complete.

notes: Phase rule: all experiments -> cooperation-dynamics (coop). 23 live experiment dirs at phase root (8.1-8.20) plus 6 archived experiments nested one level under archive/. Within-phase 8.20 collision handled: p8:8.20-clean-hidden-runtime and p8:8.20-pure-zero-perception disambiguated by slug per phase rule. Additional collision: archive/ holds predecessors of 8.2-8.7 sharing slugs with live versions; archive 8.3-8.7 share the EXACT slug of their live counterparts so their legacy_id was disambiguated with an 'archive-' prefix plus slug to keep IDs unique (the live versions keep p8:8.3..p8:8.7). archive/8.2-unsignposted-workspace has a distinct slug from live 8.2-guarded-workspace-baseline so it is disambiguated by slug alone. 'confirmatory-hidden-runtime' is a support/data dir (only a runs/ subdir, no experiment-ID prefix, no README) and is listed in phase_root_docs. BEHAVIOR-ANALYSIS.md and RUN-CATALOG.md are phase-level analysis docs. experiment_type values taken verbatim from frontmatter (benchmark-campaign, ablation, ablation-ladder, scaling, replication, discoverability-contrast, validation-control). Theory objects inferred from Paper Feeds + content: stigmergy-as-carrier for fs_mutations/file-mediated/blackboard perception lines; carrier + delayed-addressability for runtime process-surface discoverability; protocol-emergence for ctl+USR1 signal-channel emergence; viability-pressure for scarcity pressure; coordination-closure throughout; identity-criterion where world identity binding is the IV; narrative-claim for cross-model generalization. Closed-vocabulary only.
